Please note: To demount Hep2O fittings you will need to purchase either the HepKey Set (1208J) or the HepKey Plus Set (5222J).

Push-fit system, no tools required. In4Sure joint recognition lets you know when the pipe is connected. Brass plated (for hot and cold water use). Secure demounting with the HepKey system. Safe for drinking water.
